decision.shared_thesis: The 7450 wall tap-and-reject played out fully (dom_neg_strike rolled 7450->7415, price -41pts) validating the prior short thesis; SPX/SPY/QQQ are now all sitting right at their first meaningful support cluster (SPX ~7405-7415 pocket with king 7440 far above, SPY 738/739, QQQ 673-674) after a sharp negative-gamma flush. Net gamma still negative argues the down-move isn't necessarily over, but price is now AT support rather than at a fresh wall to fade, so risk/reward for a fresh short entry here is worse than it was at 7450.
